mentions.name: Fala Gringo
mentions.description: A free, open source, flashcard-based language-learning tool for teaching Brazilian Portuguese, focused on verb and vocabulary drilling where the learner sees English and produces the Portuguese. Includes a "Foco" mode that smartly selects which flashcards to drill each day. The site is fully static with no build step, works on all platforms and browsers without installation, and offers optional account-less cross-device progress sync through a tiny worker keyed by a sync code.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've gotten quite far on my free, open source, language-learning tool for teaching Brazilian Portuguese. It's flashcard based, focused on verb/vocabulary-drilling, where you get the English version and have to produce the Portuguese. There's also a "Foco"-mode, with smartness in what flashcards to drill per day.
